section: Awesome API Security Essentials / 🎳 OWASP API Top 10 2023
name: OWASP API Top 10 - 2023
desc: Why?

section: Awesome API Security Essentials / 🎳 OWASP API Top 10 2023
name: API1:2023 - Broken Object Level Authorization
desc: API endpoints often expose object identifiers, which can be manipulated by unauthorized users. It's critical to verify permissions for each request.

section: Awesome API Security Essentials / 🎳 OWASP API Top 10 2023
name: API2:2023 - Broken Authentication
desc: If authentication is implemented poorly, attackers can hijack user sessions or impersonate users. Always verify the user's identity in a secure way.

section: Awesome API Security Essentials / 🎳 OWASP API Top 10 2023
name: API3:2023 - Broken Object Property Level Authorization
desc: APIs must also verify permissions for individual object properties. Without this, attackers can access or manipulate data they shouldn't have access to.

section: Awesome API Security Essentials / 🎳 OWASP API Top 10 2023
name: API4:2023 - Unrestricted Resource Consumption
desc: APIs need to handle resource limitations effectively. If not managed properly, excessive requests can lead to service outages or increased operational costs.

section: Awesome API Security Essentials / 🎳 OWASP API Top 10 2023
name: API5:2023 - Broken Function Level Authorization
desc: APIs must manage user roles and permissions correctly. If not, users could gain unauthorized access to certain functionalities.

section: Awesome API Security Essentials / 🎳 OWASP API Top 10 2023
name: API6:2023 - Unrestricted Access to Sensitive Business Flows
desc: APIs should protect business operations. Without protection, automated or excessive usage of business functionalities could cause damage.

section: Awesome API Security Essentials / 🎳 OWASP API Top 10 2023
name: API7:2023 - Server Side Request Forgery
desc: APIs must validate external resource requests to prevent attackers from forcing the server to send requests to unauthorized locations.

section: Awesome API Security Essentials / 🎳 OWASP API Top 10 2023
name: API8:2023 - Security Misconfiguration
desc: API settings should be configured properly. Neglecting to do so can leave vulnerabilities that attackers can exploit.

section: Awesome API Security Essentials / 🎳 OWASP API Top 10 2023
name: API9:2023 - Improper Inventory Management
desc: APIs must maintain accurate and updated documentation of all available endpoints to prevent the exposure of deprecated or debug endpoints.

section: Awesome API Security Essentials / 🎳 OWASP API Top 10 2023
name: API10:2023 - Unsafe Consumption of APIs
desc: Developers should be careful when using third-party APIs and not trust them blindly. Attackers could exploit these third-party services to compromise your API.
